title: Yeasty Cauliflower
method: Preheat the oven to Gas Mark 7.
Chop the cauliflower into bite-sized pieces.
In a large bowl, toss the cauliflower with oil. Add all the spices and toss to coat.
Transfer the cauliflower to a large baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast for 30 minutes, tossing halfway through, or until crispy and tender.
